game_title: Off By One Fixer – Canopy Walkway Defense
game_concept: A tower defense set in Mystic Forest – Canopy Walkway, rope walkways in the canopy: the fairy gardener must handle bramble beasts while practicing control flow: for loops. Core idea – Off By One Fixer: Fix range boundaries that skip or overshoot by one.
theme: Mystic Forest – Canopy Walkway: rope walkways in the canopy
core_gameplay_loop: In Canopy Walkway, repeat each round: Fix range boundaries that skip or overshoot by one. Each round, bramble beasts strike the vine bridge, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the fixes value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Hint tokens that reveal one line of code
player_objective: Protect the vine bridge from bramble beasts in Canopy Walkway: keep the fixes meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 46-second timer ends.
controls: Touch: tap tiles or buttons to choose values, swipe to move, long-press for a hint.
lose_condition: fixes drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 46-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 5 – Control Flow: For Loops | Level 10 (extended tier): Off By One Fixer
